Thanks Ben — quick pass below and attached a tightened hero (hero_options_v2.docx). Overall this is in good shape. My notes inline: 

- Hero: lean into "predictable inference economics" rather than generic "enterprise" language. Suggested header: "Predictable inference economics for production LLMs" — shorter, benefit-first.
- Subhead: add one sentence that calls out deployment flexibility (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) — that's a strong differentiator on the page.
- Bullets: convert technical bullets to 4 short lines: low-latency serving; cost controls (batching/quantization); deployment parity; enterprise SLAs. Avoid exact throughput numbers on the public page.
- Compliance: Move SOC 2 to a small icon line ("SOC 2 Type II"), keep detailed security/retention language to the tech spec PDF.

Minor: change "per-token" phrasing to "usage-based" in the public-facing copy, we can show examples in the pricing modal.

Happy to hop on a 15-min to finalize. I cc'd Marcus for visibility on co-sell badge asks — Marcus, can you confirm if we should include an AWS Co-Sell readiness note or keep that separate?

Laura Bennett

Thanks — good direction. A few practical notes from the Marketplace/legal side: 

- SKU & pricing: AWS requires each SKU to map to a single BOM/offer. For our tiers that means we need discrete SKUs for Developer / Production / Enterprise with clear support levels. I sketched mappings and minimum commitment language in the attached (also pasted below).
- Claims: do not use comparative claims ("faster than X")==> replace with measurable outcomes ("median p95 latency < X ms on N1-standard equivalents") only in the technical spec. Public page keep benefit statements qualitative.
- Support plan: marketplace product page asks for the support plan name and response SLA; please confirm we want "Business" for Production and "Enterprise Premium" for Enterprise.
- Co-sell: Marcus — we need a short sentence confirming co-sell eligibility and the partner contact. If we plan to push for Co-Sell, add the readiness checklist (I can attach).

I copied Marcus to help with the badge & legal sign-off. HubSpot: ACME-57 updated with the pricing sketch — https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/ACME-57

Karthik
Head of Marketplace & Legal Enablement | Redwood Inference
